SELECT s.id, s.warehouse_id, w.code AS warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, s.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, s.batch_no, s.location_id, l.code AS location_code, l.name AS location_name, s.qty, m.safety_stock, (m.safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND s.qty < m.safety_stock) AS below_safety, s.update_time FROM inv_stock s LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = s.material_id LEFT JOIN base_location l ON l.id = s.location_id WHERE s.deleted = 0
AND s.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId}
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND s.qty != 0 AND s.qty = 0
AND m.safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND s.qty < m.safety_stock
ORDER BY s.id DESC

SELECT s.id AS stock_id, s.warehouse_id, w.code AS warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, m.id AS material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, COALESCE(s.qty, 0) AS qty, m.safety_stock, (m.safety_stock - COALESCE(s.qty, 0)) AS shortage FROM base_material m LEFT JOIN (SELECT warehouse_id, material_id, SUM(qty) AS qty, MIN(id) AS id FROM inv_stock WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY warehouse_id, material_id) s ON s.material_id = m.id AND s.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId} LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s.qty, 0) < m.safety_stock
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY (m.safety_stock - COALESCE(s.qty, 0)) DESC, m.id
